scope: New-to-this-campaign retrospective 12-US-survivor public sample; no global, point-in-time or profitability claim
selection_policy: Named before acquisition or outcomes. KO excluded due to prior engineering calibration, replaced by HON after metadata-only check. No outcome-based replacements.
target: Next declared month-end to month-end log adjusted-close return in each listing's local quotation currency, using a full-month information gap before the decision
timing_policy: For target month M, decide at the start of M-1 using inputs ending M-3; enter at the last source daily observation of M-1 and exit at the last of M. Month indices are research coordinates, not verified exchange execution/publication timestamps. No executed-fill claim.
public_source_limitations: Yahoo histories are retrieved today and may contain revisions and retrospective adjustments.
Adjusted-close returns are provider-adjusted return proxies; raw action reconciliation and historical publication timestamps are not certified.
Only present-day named listings are selected; delisted and bankrupt companies are missing.
No FX conversion is performed. Local-currency stock ledgers cannot be combined into an investable global portfolio.
Single optimization seed and five epochs support a bounded exploratory comparison only.
Monthly crisis blocks are short and correlated; bootstrap intervals are exploratory and multiple crisis comparisons are unadjusted.
Protected 2025 onward price observations are excluded. This study does not consume or amend the canonical confirmatory freeze.
